protocol: bench_unified_timing.py: uniform runoff 2 mm/day, steady state of that forcing shared by all configurations, 10 warm-up steps then the mean over 600 routing time steps, three repeats per configuration with the median reported; SURGE compiled with torch.compile and timed at the iteration count each river network needs (field k); GPU-ordered does not iterate
machine: NVIDIA A100-SXM4-40GB on a whole ASPIRE 2A node
note: Measured after the reservoir router was rewritten: the sweep no longer touches the whole grid to write a few hundred cells, and the level loop no longer asks the device, once per level, whether that level holds a dam. none = no reservoir code, code_only = the code with no reservoir in it, dams = the GRanD dams. The previous version is kept as reservoir_timing.json.bak_20260926_prev3.
